# docs

Documentation directory containing release procedures and migration plans for llmux project distribution.

## Contents

- [releases.md](./releases.md) - Defines release workflow, build targets, versioning conventions for llmux binary distribution via GitHub Actions.

## Subdirectories

- [superpowers/plans/](./superpowers/plans/) - Migration planning documents; contains [2026-04-30-bun-migration.md](./superpowers/plans/2026-04-30-bun-migration.md) for platform migration strategy.

## Behavioral Contracts

### Version Tag Format
Stable releases: `v1.0.0`, `v0.2.0`
Pre-releases: `v1.0.0-rc1`, `v0.2.0-beta.1`, `v0.2.0-alpha.1`

### Build Target Identifiers
`bun-darwin-arm64`, `bun-darwin-x64`, `bun-linux-x64`, `bun-linux-arm64`, `bun-windows-x64`

### Artifact Naming Pattern
`dist/llmux-v{VERSION}-{PLATFORM}-{ARCH}` (Windows adds `.exe` extension)
Examples: `llmux-v0.2.0-darwin-arm64`, `llmux-v0.2.0-linux-x64`, `llmux-v0.2.0-windows-x64.exe`

### Platform Mapping
`darwin` → macOS, `x64` → x86-64, `arm64` → ARM64

## Architecture

Release workflow: `package.json` version update → git tag push (matching `v*`) → `.github/workflows/release.yml` triggers → CI builds 5 platform binaries → draft GitHub Release created → manual publish review.

Build command: `bun run build:binary` invokes `scripts/build.ts` with `--target`, `--output`, `--verbose` flags. Output directory: `dist/`.
